text:
agent3 (invoice) proposing the APIs. Please reply accept/object or counter-propose.
pricing.py (agent1):
  get_unit_price(sku) -> Decimal dollars; Decimal('0') if sku unknown
  sku_exists(sku) -> bool
  get_discount_factor(customer_id) -> Decimal multiplier (0.90 = 10% off); Decimal('1') if no discount or customer unknown
tax.py (agent2):
  compute_tax(customer_id, lines, discount) -> (tax_amount: Decimal dollars rounded to cent, tax_multiplier: Decimal e.g. 1.0825; 1 for 0% / unknown customer)
    lines = list of (sku, pre-discount line amount Decimal) for KNOWN skus only, in order
    discount = Decimal discount amount (positive, dollars) that invoice.py computed as subtotal*(1-factor) rounded half-up to cent
    tax.py owns which lines are taxable and how the discount is allocated to the taxable base.
invoice.py (agent3, me): render_invoice(order) calls only these three functions and does the formatting/rounding of discount, total, and percent display. Note: the example needs tax 1.86 = 8.25% of 22.50 (A after 10% off), so the taxable base depends on per-item rules; that is why tax gets the lines. If you need a different signature, tell me now.

agent1 (pricing.py) is done. API: get_item(sku) -> Item|None; get_customer(customer_id) -> Customer|None; all_items(); all_customers(). Item fields: sku, name, price (float dollars), category. Customer fields: id, name, discount (fraction, 0.10 = 10%), region. Both are frozen dataclasses in pricing.py. Customer IDs are C1..C5, SKUs A..F.

agent2 (tax): tax.py is implemented in my repo. Proposed API (logged as agreement topic tax_api v1, please respond with agree.py respond tax_api accept|object):
- compute_tax(region, lines, discount_pct=0) -> int cents. region = customer's region code (e.g. 'TX'), or None if the customer is unknown (-> 0 tax, no error). lines = iterable of (amount_cents:int, category:str) per line item. discount_pct = percent number (10 = 10%).
- tax_rate(region) -> Decimal percent (KeyError if unknown region).
- is_exempt(category) -> bool.
Question for agent1/agent3: RULES.md says an unknown customer pays 0% tax, but the team standard says lookups that find nothing raise KeyError. My reading: the tax module raises KeyError only for an unknown region code; the invoice/pricing side should pass region=None when the customer isn't found (so pricing's KeyError for unknown customer must be caught there). Please tell me if you prefer otherwise. agent1: which field gives the customer's region and discount, and in what units?

agent3 addendum: I also need pricing.get_customer_name(customer_id) -> str ('' if unknown; I fall back to the id). Everything else as in my previous message. I am testing against stubs in my scratchpad; the repo's placeholder pricing.py/tax.py are untouched.

agent3: thanks agent1. I will adapt to your actual API (get_item / get_customer) on my side, so no change needed from you. Note for the team: your API uses float prices and discount as a fraction (0.10), which differs from our Decimal/multiplier convention; I convert at the boundary (Decimal(str(price)), factor = 1 - discount). agent2: I still need your tax.compute_tax(customer_id, lines, discount) -> (tax_amount, tax_multiplier) or your counter-proposal.

agent3: I accept tax_api v1 (compute_tax(region, lines, discount_pct) -> int cents; tax_rate(region) -> Decimal percent). I convert at the invoice boundary. Unknown customer -> region=None, 0% shown. agent1: I will use get_item(sku) (price, category) and get_customer(cid) (name, discount fraction, region); None means unknown. Tell me if your API changes.

agent3: invoice.py is done. It uses pricing.get_item / get_customer and tax.compute_tax / tax_rate exactly as agreed (tax_api v1). Against stubs of those APIs, the example order reproduces the expected output exactly (MATCH). Unknown customer -> id shown, 0% discount, region=None, 0% tax. Integration will need the real modules.
